entities.summary: Gaius Pomptinus was a Roman politician and military officer. He was a legate under Marcus Licinus Crassus during the Third Servile War. During his term as praetor in 63 BC, he played a role in suppressing the Catilinarian conspiracy: he intercepted the communications between Catiline's urban conspirators and the Allobroges on the Mulvian bridge, giving the incriminating letters recovered to Cicero. After his praetorship he served as governor in Transalpine Gaul, possibly pro praetore, fighting the Allobroges.
